description: Yaoguai usually begin as simple animals, plants, or objects before finding a way to awaken to sapience, becoming strange shapeshifting creatures in the process.

features.name: Awakened Nature
features.tldr: Your origins as an awakened object, plant, or beast give you unique biological adaptations.

features.name: Ancestry Heritage
features.tldr: Choose a yaoguai heritage representing whether you originated from flora, fauna, or an object.
